This is a list of '''characters in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''''', listed roughly in their appearance in the game. Note that the order in which some of these characters appear in-game depends upon the sequence in which the player completes certain missions.

==Protagonist==
{| class="wikitable"
![[File:CJ-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Carl Johnson]]'''
|Carl Johnson, also known as '''CJ''',is the main protagonist and playable character throughout ''GTA San Andreas''. After he has resided at [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]] for [[1987|five years]] to escape from the pressures of life, he was informed by his brother that his [[Beverly Johnson|mother]] was murdered which is why he is returning from Liberty City to [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]]. He misses the funeral but decides to stay and prove his loyalty to his brother [[Sean Johnson|Sweet]] and to the [[Grove Street Families]]. Carl then begins to help the Grove Street Families and weaken their rivals, as well as establishing a business empire throughout the [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|State of San Andreas]].<br />Voiced by [[Young Maylay|Young Maylay (Chris Bellard)]].
|}

==Antagonist==
{| class="wikitable"
!Character
!Range of Missions
!Description
|-
! [[File:FrankTenpenny-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Frank Tenpenny]]'''
| [[In the Beginning]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Frank Tenpenny is the main antagonist of GTA San Andreas. He is a police officer with the [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|Los Santos Police Department]] and heads up [[C.R.A.S.H.]]. He and partner [[Eddie Pulaski]], who are joined by new partner [[Jimmy Hernandez]], are involved in creating trouble for the gangs of Los Santos and in particular for Carl Johnson. Tenpenny frames Carl for the murder of [[Ralph Pendelbury]] and later employs him to tackle the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] and [[Los Santos Vagos (3D Universe)|Los Santos Vagos]]. Tenpenny later leaves Los Santos and continues to have Carl perform various tasks for him. He later turns on Hernandez and is put on trial. Tenpenny is acquitted, which sparks riots in the city. Tenpenny attempts to escape in a [[Firetruck (3D Universe)|Firetruck]] but is killed when he drives off a bridge and into [[Grove Street (3D Universe)|Grove Street]]. His corpse is later mutilated and stripped by the homeless.<br />Voiced by [[Samuel L. Jackson]].
|}

==Main Characters==
{| class="wikitable"
!Character
!Range of Missions
!Description
|-
![[File:EddiePulaski-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Eddie Pulaski]]'''
| [[In the Beginning]] {{nd}} [[High Noon]]
|Eddie Pulaski is a police officer with the [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|Los Santos Police Department]] and [[Frank Tenpenny|Frank Tenpenny's]] partner in crime. He trusts Tenpenny and also works alongside [[Jimmy Hernandez]]. He works alongside Tenpenny and Hernandez, constantly interrupting Carl Johnson's life. He later kills Hernandez, before being killed by Carl Johnson.<br />Voiced by [[Chris Penn]].
|-
![[File:BigSmoke-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Big Smoke|Melvin Harris<br />(Big Smoke)]]'''
| [[Big Smoke (mission)|Big Smoke]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Melvin Harris, also known as '''Big Smoke''', is a leading member of the Grove Street Families who lives in [[Idlewood]]. He welcomes Carl's return to the gang and assists Carl in helping the Grove Street Families return to dominance. However, he does so in a limited way, later joining forces with the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]], the Grove Street Families' main rival, in order to become involved in the drugs trade, which Sweet had refused to do. He also works in league with the [[Los Santos Vagos (3D Universe)|Los Santos Vagos]], [[Russian Mafia (3D Universe)|Russian Mafia]] and the [[San Fierro Rifa]]. Whilst Carl is away from Los Santos, he becomes the city's drug baron and hides himself in a building in [[Los Flores]]. He is later killed by Carl for betraying the Grove Street Families.<br />Voiced by [[Clifton Powell]].
|-
![[File:SeanJohnson-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Sweet Johnson|Sean Johnson<br />(Sweet)]]'''
| [[Sweet & Kendl]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Sean Johnson, also known as '''Sweet''', is the leader of the [[Grove Street Families]] and the older brother of Carl, [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl]] and [[Brian Johnson|Brian]]. He has an unnamed girlfriend. Sweet is initially skeptical about Carl's loyalty, blaming him for the death of Brian, but eventually accepts his brother back into the gang. He is arrested by the [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|police]], before being released after [[Mike Toreno]] arranged for his release in return for a favor from Carl. He returns to his home in [[Ganton]] and helps to re-assert the Grove Street Families dominance in the area.<br />Voiced by [[Faizon Love]].
|-
![[File:LanceWilson-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Ryder|Lance Wilson<br />(Ryder)]]'''
| [[Sweet & Kendl]] {{nd}} [[Pier 69 (mission)|Pier 69]]
|Lance Wilson, also known as '''Ryder''', is a leading member of the [[Grove Street Families (3D Universe)|Grove Street Families]] who lives in [[Ganton]]. He welcomes Carl's return to the gang and works with Carl to obtain weapons for the gang, stealing them from [[Colonel Fuhrberger]] and a National Guard weapons depot. However, he later joins the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]], the Grove Street Families' main rival, and becomes heavily involved in the drugs trade. Ryder is killed by Carl after fleeing from a meeting with [[T-Bone Mendez]], which had been interrupted by Carl and [[Cesar Vialpando]].<br />Voiced by [[MC Eiht]].
|-
![[File:KendlJohnson-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Kendl Johnson]]'''
| [[Sweet & Kendl]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Kendl Johnson is the sister of Carl, Sweet and Brian, and the girlfriend of [[Cesar Vialpando]]. Her relationship with Cesar leads to an alliance between Carl and Cesar. She leaves Los Santos for [[Angel Pine]] after the Ballas and Los Santos Vagos take over large parts of the city. She later becomes heavily involved in Carl's business adventures, primarily his [[Doherty Garage|garage]] and the [[Four Dragons Casino]]. She later returns to Los Santos with Cesar Vialpando, who at one point told Carl that he planned on asking her to marry him.<br />Voiced by [[Yolanda Whittaker|Yo-Yo (Yolanda Whittaker)]].
|-
![[File:CesarVialpando-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Cesar Vialpando]]'''
| [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|Cesar Vialpando]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Cesar Vialpando is the leader of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas (3D Universe)|Varrios Los Aztecas]] gang and the boyfriend of [[Kendl Johnson]]. He lives in [[El Corona]]. He later becomes an ally of Carl's, through his relationship with Kendl, and later helps him in his business adventures. He is forced to leave Los Santos, when the Ballas and Los Santos Vagos take over large parts of the city. He introduces Carl to his cousin, [[Catalina]], and later helps Carl re-assert the Grove Street Families dominance in Ganton. He also talks to Carl about proposing to Kendl.<br />Voiced by [[Clifton Collins Jr.]].
|-
![[File:OGLoc-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[OG Loc (3D Universe)|Jeffrey Cross<br />(OG Loc)]]'''<br /> 
| [[OG Loc (mission)|OG Loc]] {{nd}} [[Cut Throat Business]]
|Jeffrey Cross, also known as '''OG Loc''', is a amateur rapper and an associate of the [[Grove Street Families]]. He is imprisoned and released from prison in [[1992]]. Upon his release he starts working for [[Burger Shot (3D Universe)|Burger Shot]] and begins to employ Carl to help his rap career get started. This includes killing [[Freddy (GTA San Andreas)|Freddy]], a fellow inmate, and [[Alan Crawford]], [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]]'s manager. Carl's actions lead to Madd Dogg's career being derailed, allowing Loc to take his place. Loc is later managed by [[Big Smoke]] and finds initial success. However Carl and Madd Dogg later chase Loc through western [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] and manage to corner Loc, taking Madd Dogg's rhyme book back(after Carl had stolen it for Loc).<br />Voiced by [[Jonathan Anderson]]
|-
![[File:Catalina-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Catalina]]'''
| [[First Date (GTA San Andreas)|First Date]] {{nd}} [[Farewell, My Love...]]
|Catalina is [[Cesar Vialpando|Cesar Vialpando's]] cousin who lives in a secluded shack in the [[Fern Ridge]] area. She hates men, with the exception of her boyfriends. She meets Carl in [[Dillimore]] and the two begin to rob several businesses in the countryside. The two begin a relationship, which quickly ends due Catalina's anger with Carl's obsession with getting money. She finds a new boyfriend, [[Claude]], and leaves [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]] for [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]]. However, she later attempts to win Carl back through phone calls.<br />Voiced by [[Cynthia Farrell]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]''.
|-
![[File:TheTruth-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[The Truth]]'''
| [[Body Harvest]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|The Truth is an aging hippie who lives in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] and owns a farm on the outskirts of the city. He becomes a friend of Carl Johnson when Carl steals a [[Combine Harvester|combine harvester]] and sets fire to his farm's illegal crops. The Truth also introduces Carl to [[Dwaine]], [[Jethro]] and [[Zero]], later helping Carl become friends with [[Kent Paul]] and [[Maccer]]. He later has Carl steal a [[jetpack]] from [[Area 69 (3D Universe)|Area 69]] and a container of an unknown "green goo". He later states his admiration for Carl, who has beaten the system.<br />Voiced by [[Peter Fonda]].
|-
![[File:Woozie-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Wu Zi Mu]]'''
| [[Wu Zi Mu (mission)|Wu Zi Mu]] {{nd}} [[A Home in the Hills]] or [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's]]
|Wu Zi Mu, also known as '''Woozie''', is the blind leader of the Mountain Cloud Boys, a sub-sect of the [[San Fierro Triads]], who resides and owns a betting shop in [[Chinatown (GTA San Andreas)|Chinatown]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. He meets Carl Johnson in a street race, which Carl wins. Wu Zi Mu later employs Carl to help his boss [[Ran Fa Li]] and to tackle the [[Da Nang Boys]], before pulling of a heist at the [[Mafia]] owned [[Caligula's Palace]] casino in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]]. Wu Zi Mu later helps Carl to take back [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg's]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]].<br />Voiced by [[James Yaegashi]].
|-
![[File:Zero-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Zero]]'''
| [[Wear Flowers in Your Hair]] {{nd}} [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's]]
|
Zero is a [[1964|28-year old]] electronics expert and owner of the [[Zero RC]] shop in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]], later running the store for new owner Carl Johnson. His archenemy is [[Berkley]], owner of [[Top Fun]], with Zero employing Carl to disrupt Berkley's business and eventually forcing him to leave the city following a miniature "war game". He later provides electronic equipment for a heist at [[Caligula's Palace]], although he is later punched by Carl for putting the heist at risk from [[Las Venturas Police Department|police]] intervention.<br />Voiced by [[David Cross]].
|-
![[File:JizzyB-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Jizzy B.]]'''
| [[Photo Opportunity]] {{nd}} [[Ice Cold Killa]]
|Jizzy B. is the owner of the [[Jizzy's Pleasure Domes|Pleasure Domes club]] in [[Battery Point]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] and is the cities biggest pimp. He is a member of the [[Loco Syndicate]], alongside [[T-Bone Mendez]] and [[Mike Toreno]], which is involved in the manufacturing and supplying of drugs. He employs Carl to stop rivals from stealing drugs and to save Mike Toreno. However, he is later killed by Carl for supplying drugs to the [[Grove Street Families]] and to [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]].<br />Voiced by: [[Charlie Murphy]].
|-
![[File:T-BoneMendez-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[T-Bone Mendez]]'''
| [[Photo Opportunity]] {{nd}} [[Pier 69 (mission)|Pier 69]]
|T-Bone Mendez is the leader of the [[San Fierro Rifa]] and a member of the [[Loco Syndicate]], alongside [[Jizzy B.]] and [[Mike Toreno]], which is involved in the manufacturing and supplying of drugs. He distrusts Carl Johnson but works alongside Carl to rescue Mike Toreno. He is later killed by Carl Johnson and [[Cesar Vialpando]] for supplying drugs to the [[Grove Street Families]] and to [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]].<br />Voiced by: [[Kid Frost]].
|-
![[File:MikeToreno-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Mike Toreno]]'''
| [[Photo Opportunity]] {{nd}} [[Home Coming]]
|Mike Toreno is an undercover agent for an unknown government agency who becomes involved in the drugs trade, alongside [[Jizzy B.]] and [[T-Bone Mendez]]. He becomes an ally of Carl's through the drugs trade, however, Carl later attempts to kill Toreno. Despite this, Toreno employs Carl to do government-related missions and is later has Sweet released from prison.<br />Voiced by [[James Woods]].
|-
![[File:KentPaul-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Kent Paul]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Kent Paul is the record producer of English band [[The Gurning Chimps (3D Universe)|The Gurning Chimps]], bringing the band to [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]]. He meets Carl Johnson when Carl rescues Paul and [[Maccer]], who had been stranded in the desert. Kent Paul then introduces Carl to [[Ken Rosenberg]], allowing Carl to get inside knowledge of Caligula's Palace. Carl later helps Kent escape from [[Salvatore Leone]], with Kent becoming involved in getting [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg's]] career back on track.<br />Voiced by [[Danny Dyer]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
![[File:Maccer-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Maccer]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Maccer is the lead singer of The Gurning Chimps band and is originally from Manchester in the [[United Kingdom]]. He and Kent Paul are rescued by Carl Johnson, having been stranded in the desert, and then again from the clutches of [[Salvatore Leone]]. Maccer continues to accompany Kent Paul, however, he is mocked by Carl and Sweet due to his uncontrollable sexual tendencies.<br />Voiced by [[Shaun Ryder]].
|-
![[File:KenRosenberg-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ken Rosenberg]]'''
| [[Don Peyote]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Ken Rosenberg is the manager of [[Caligula's Palace]], which is owned by three [[Mafia]] families: the [[Leone Crime Family|Leones]], [[Forelli Crime Family|Forellis]] and [[Sindacco Crime Family|Sindaccos]]. Fearing his own death at the hands of one of the families, he quickly returns to drug use, having only recently become sober. Rosenberg later employs Carl Johnson to prevent a war breaking out between the three families, before eventually escaping with help from Carl. He then becomes an accountant for [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]].<br />Voiced by [[William Fichtner]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
![[File:MaddDogg-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]]'''
| [[Madd Dogg (mission)|Madd Dogg]] {{nd}} [[End of the Line]]
|Madd Dogg is a rapper from [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]], who resides in a [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] in [[Mulholland]]. When Carl Johnson returns to Los Santos, Madd Dogg is at the height of his career, having just launched his own line of clothing. However, he later begins to suffer from depression after Carl Johnson begins to sabotage his career, by stealing his rhyme book and killing his manager, [[Alan Crawford]]. Madd Dogg later flees to [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]], having given his mansion to [[Big Poppa]] in exchange for drugs. He attempts to commit suicide but is rescued by Carl, who later becomes his manager and helps to re-build his career. Madd Dogg went on to release a gold record by the end of [[1992]].<br />Voiced by [[Ice-T]].
|}

He is forced to kill [[Ralph Pendelbury]] to prove his loyalty and later, alongside Tenpenny and Pulaski, interrupt Carl Johnson's life on numerous, having him perform various tasks. Hernandez later decides to give evidence against his colleagues, leading to Pulaski killing him.<br />Voiced by [[Armando Riesco]].

He is drifting away from the Grove Street Families, eventually joining the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]]. He has also "enslaved" [[Big Bear]], who eventually turns on B Dup and enters rehab.<br />Voiced by: [[The Game]].

He later turns on B Dup, his drug supplier, and enters rehab, being welcomed back to the Grove Street Families by Carl Johnson and [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet]].<br />Voiced by: [[Kurt Alexander|Big Boy (Kurt Alexander)]].

![[File:Dwaine-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Dwaine]]'''<br />
| [[Wear Flowers in Your Hair]] {{nd}} [[Puncture Wounds]]
|Dwaine is a mechanic who runs a hot dog van in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. [[The Truth]] introduces him to Carl Johnson, who employs him at his [[Doherty Garage|garage]] in [[Doherty (3D Universe)|Doherty]], San Fierro.<br />Voiced by: [[Navid Khonsari]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
![[File:Jethro-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Jethro]]'''<br />
| [[Wear Flowers in Your Hair]] {{nd}} [[Puncture Wounds]]
|Jethro is a mechanic working for a [[Xoomer]] Gas Station in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. [[The Truth]] introduces him to Carl Johnson, who employs him at his [[Doherty Garage|garage]] in [[Doherty (3D Universe)|Doherty]], San Fierro.<br />Voiced by: [[John Zurhellen]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
![[File:RanFaLi-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ran Fa Li]]'''
| [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|Ran Fa Li]] {{nd}} [[Fish in a Barrel]]
|Ran Fa Li, also known as '''Farlie''', is the leader of the Red Gecko Tong sub-sect of the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He does not speak, only grunting, although his assistant [[Su Xi Mu]] translates for him. He is [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi Mu's]] superior and has Carl Johnson work for him, acting as a decoy to allow him to escape the [[Da Nang Thang]]. He later becomes co-owner of the [[Four Dragons Casino]], alongside Carl and Wu Zi Mu.<br />Voiced by: [[Hunter Platin]].
|-
![[File:JohnnySindacco-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Johnny Sindacco]]'''
| [[Fender Ketchup]] {{nd}} [[The Meat Business]]
|Johnny Sindacco is a leading member of the [[Sindacco Crime Family]], who own the [[Caligula's Palace]] casino in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]]. He convinces [[Salvatore Leone]] to invest $5 million in the casino and later begins to damage slot machines in the [[San Fierro Triads|Triad]]-owned [[Four Dragons Casino]]. Carl Johnson has him tied to the hood of car and scares him into telling him which [[Mafia]] family he is with. He is later targeted by the [[Forelli Crime Family]], although Carl rescues him, although Johnny later dies of a heart attack after recognizing Carl.<br />Voiced by [[Casey Siemaszko]].
|-
![[File:SalvatoreLeone-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Salvatore Leone]]'''
| [[Freefall]] {{nd}} [[Saint Mark's Bistro]]
|Salvatore Leone is the [[Boss|Don]] of the [[Leone Crime Family]] who resides in [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]]. He has invested $5 million in [[Caligula's Palace]] and owns one third of the casino, alongside the [[Forelli Crime Family|Forelli]] and [[Sindacco Crime Family|Sindacco]] families. He employs Carl in order to gain a larger share of the casino, however, Carl later pulls off a heist at the casino alongside [[Wu Zi Mu]] and the [[San Fierro Triads]]. Whilst in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]], he meets his future wife [[Maria Latore]].<br />Voiced by [[Frank Vincent]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'' and ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]''.
|}

![[File:Michelle-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Michelle Cannes]]'''
| Does not appear in a mission
|Michelle Cannes is a mechanic who resides at her [[Michelle's Auto Repair|garage]] in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. She can, depending on the player's choice, become Carl Johnson's girlfriend.<br />Voiced by: [[Vanessa Aspillaga]].
|-
![[File:SuXiMu-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Su Xi Mu]]'''
| [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|Ran Fa Li]] {{nd}} [[Lure (GTA San Andreas)|Lure]]
|Su Xi Mu, also known as '''Suzie''', is [[Ran Fa Li|Ran Fa Li's]] assistant. He translates Ran Fa Li's grunts into orders for Wu Zi Mu and Carl Johnson.<br />Voiced by: [[Richard Chang]]
|-
![[File:LittleLion-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Little Lion]]'''
| [[The Da Nang Thang]]
|Little Lion is a member of the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He informs [[Wu Zi Mu]] of a freighter being used by the [[Da Nang Boys]]. He and Carl attack the freighter from a helicopter, which is shot down, killing Little Lion.<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Little Lion.
|-
![[File:Snakehead-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[The Snakehead]]'''
|[[The Da Nang Thang]]
| The Snakehead is presumably the leader of the Da Nang Boys, and attempts to arrive in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] from Vietnam via cargo ship. After rescuing several Vietnamese hostages from the ship, [[Carl Johnson|Carl]] has a brief sword fight with the Snakehead and kills him.
|-
![[File:BarbaraSchternvart-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Barbara Schternvart]]'''
| Does not appear in a mission
|Barbara Schternvart is a police officer who resides in [[El Quebrados]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. She can, depending on the player's choice, become Carl Johnson's girlfriend.<br />Voiced by: [[Danielle Lee Greaves]].
|-
![[File:Mike-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Mike (GTA San Andreas)|Mike]]'''
| [[The Introduction]] {{nd}} [[The Meat Business]]
|Mike is a Leone mobster enlisted by [[Salvatore Leone]] to be [[Ken Rosenberg]]'s bodyguard in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]].
|-
![[File:Tony-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Tony]]'''
| [[Intensive Care]] {{nd}} [[Freefall]]
|Tony is a talking parrot who resides at [[Caligula's Palace]] and is a companion to [[Ken Rosenberg]].<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Tony.
|-
![[File:MariaLaTorra-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Maria Latore]]'''
| [[Freefall]] {{nd}} [[Saint Mark's Bistro]]
|Maria Latore, also referred to as '''Maria La Torra''', is a waitress at [[Caligula's Palace]] in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]]. She meets her future husband, [[Salvatore Leone]], whilst Salvatore is in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]] to run the casino.<br />Voiced by: [[Debi Mazar]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'' and ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]''.
|-
![[File:MilliePerkins-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Millie Perkins]]'''
| [[Key to Her Heart]]
|Millie Perkins is a croupier at [[Caligula's Palace]]. She resides in [[Prickle Pine]], [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]]. Carl Johnson becomes her boyfriend after he killed one of her clients, [[Benny (GTA San Andreas)|Benny]]. She can be killed during the mission [[Key to Her Heart]]. If the player does not kill Millie, she continues to appear during dates.<br />Voiced by: [[Orfeh]].
|-
![[File:Benny-GTASA-HD.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Benny (GTA San Andreas)|Benny]]'''
| [[Key to Her Heart]]
|Benny is a client of [[Millie Perkins]] who is killed by Carl Johnson.
|-
![[File:BigPoppa-GTASA.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Big Poppa]]'''
| [[A Home in the Hills]]
|Big Poppa is a drug dealer and member of the [[Los Santos Vagos (3D Universe)|Los Santos Vagos]]. He takes control of [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg's]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] in exchange for drugs. Carl Johnson and the [[San Fierro Triads]] later take the mansion back, with Carl killing Big Poppa.<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Big Poppa.
|-
![[File:JimmySilverman-GTASA-Portrait.png|100px]]<br />'''[[Jimmy Silverman]]'''
| [[Cut Throat Business]]
|Jimmy Silverman is a producer and manager working for [[Blastin' Fools Records (3D Universe)|Blastin' Fools Records]]. He had managed [[Rochell'le]] and [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]], before working with [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|OG Loc]]. Silverman later stops working with Loc, ending his rap career.<br />Voiced by: [[Gary Yudman]].
|-
![[File:Gal-GTASA-0.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Gal]]'''
|
[[Los Desperados]]
|Gal is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas (3D Universe)|Varrios Los Aztecas]] who, alongside Carl Johnson, [[Cesar Vialpando]], [[Hazer]] and [[Sunny]], helps to take back [[El Corona]] for the Varrios Los Aztecas.<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Gal.
|-
![[File:Hazer-GTASA-UnityStation.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Hazer]]'''
|
[[Los Desperados]]
|Hazer is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas (3D Universe)|Varrios Los Aztecas]] who, alongside Carl Johnson, [[Cesar Vialpando]], [[Gal]] and [[Sunny]], helps to take back [[El Corona]] for the Varrios Los Aztecas.<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Hazer.
|-
![[File:Sunny-GTASA-UnityStation.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Sunny]]'''
|
[[Los Desperados]]
|Sunny is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas (3D Universe)|Varrios Los Aztecas]] who, alongside Carl Johnson, [[Cesar Vialpando]], [[Gal]] and [[Hazer]], helps to take back [[El Corona]] for the Varrios Los Aztecas.<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Sunny.

|[[File:RalphPendelbury-GTASA.jpg|100px]]<br />'''[[Ralph Pendelbury]]'''<br />('''bottom''')
|Ralph Pendelbury is a police officer with the [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|Los Santos Police Department]]. Pendelbury, a member of [[C.R.A.S.H.]], had threatened to give evidence against [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]]. The pair force new C.R.A.S.H. member [[Jimmy Hernandez]] to kill Pendelbury during [[The Introduction]]. He is mentioned by Tenpenny, when he frames Carl Johnson for Pendelbury's death.
|-
|'''[[Mickey (GTA San Andreas)|Mickey]]'''
|Mickey was a member of the [[Sindacco Crime Family]] who ran [[Caligula's Palace]] before he was killed on orders from [[Johnny Sindacco]], to get an investment from [[Salvatore Leone]]. He is buried by Sindacco Family gang members during [[The Introduction]].
|-
|'''[[Bobby]]'''
|Bobby is, presumably, a member of the [[Sindacco Crime Family]]. He is mentioned by two Sindacco Family gang members in [[The Introduction]], stating he had recently become an open homosexual.
|-
|'''[[Beverly Johnson]]'''
|Beverly Johnson is the mother of Carl, [[Sweet Johnson|Sean (Sweet)]], [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl]] and [[Brian Johnson]]. She was killed by members of the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] during [[The Introduction]], and was mentioned in a phone conversation between Carl and Sweet. Her funeral takes place whilst Carl and [[Big Smoke|Big Smoke (Melvin Harris)]] are driving to the funeral.
|-
|'''[[Brian Johnson]]'''
|Brian Johnson was the younger brother of Carl, [[Sweet Johnson|Sean (Sweet)]] and [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl]], and the son of [[Beverly Johnson]]. Brian died in [[1987]] and his death is mentioned by Sweet after their mother's funeral, saying that Carl missed both Brian's funeral and his mothers.
|-
|'''[[Big Devil]]'''
|Big Devil was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died sometime before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet (Sean Johnson)]] whilst at his [[Beverly Johnson|mothers]] funeral.
|-
|'''[[Little Devil]]'''
|Little Devil was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died sometime before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet (Sean Johnson)]] whilst at his [[Beverly Johnson|mothers]] funeral.
|-
|'''[[Tony (GSF)|Tony]]'''
|Tony was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died sometime before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet (Sean Johnson)]] whilst at his [[Beverly Johnson|mothers]] funeral.
|-
|'''[[LB]]'''
|LB is a friend of [[Ryder|Ryder (Lance Wilson)]] who helps Ryder and Carl Johnson. He is mentioned by Ryder during the mission [[Home Invasion]], telling Ryder of some weapons and ammunition located at [[Colonel Fuhrberger|Colonel Fuhrberger's]] home in [[East Beach]], [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]].
|-
|'''[[Herbie]]'''
|Herbie is the astro-goat of [[The Truth]], who mentions Herbie during the mission [[Are You Going to San Fierro?]].
|-
|'''[[Berkley]]'''
|
Berkley is [[Zero|Zero's]] rival and the owner of the [[Berkleys RC|Berkley's RC Shop]] business. Zero mentions Berkley during five missions, with Carl disrupting Berkley's business and defeating him in a miniature war. Zero also mentions Berkley after the [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's]] mission, stating he had told Berkley of the impending heist. Upon hearing this, Carl punches him.
|-
|'''[[General Mills]]'''
|General Mills is an army general who is in charge of the [[Jetpack|Black Project]]. He is mentioned when Carl Johnson steals the jetpack for [[The Truth]] in the mission [[Black Project]].
|-
|'''[[Scott Wilson]]'''
|
Scott Wilson is a deceased resident of [[Palomino Creek]]. His tombstone can be found in the graveyard for the [[Drive-Thru Confession Church]].
|-
|[[File:TommyVercetti-GTAVC.jpg|100px]]'''[[Tommy Vercetti]]'''
|
Tommy Vercetti was metioned several times by [[Ken Rosenberg]] in [[The Introduction|The Introduction and]] in the mission [[The Meat Business]]. Tommy was the friend of Ken Rosenberg until he abandons him after Ken was sent for rehabilitation with Vercetti refusing to answer his calls. He serves as the protagonist of ''GTA Vice City''.<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City|GTA Vice City]]''
|}

!Description

|'''[[Richard Burns]]'''
|Richard Burns is a reporter for [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR News]]. He is romantically involved with [[Lianne Forget]] and is shown to be incapable of reporting without committing other crimes, including stealing.<br />Voiced by: [[Wil Wheaton]].
|-
|'''[[Billy Dexter]]'''
|Billy Dexter is the host of [[Entertaining America]] on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR]] until he is killed on air by [[Jack Howitzer (3D Universe)|Jack Howitzer]].<br />Voiced by: [[Peter Marx]].

|'''[[Darius Fontaine (3D Universe)|Darius Fontaine]]'''

|Lianne Forget is the host of [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR]] News and is romantically involved with [[Richard Burns]].<br />Voiced by: [[Sharon Washington]].
|-
|'''[[Cris Formage (3D Universe)|Cris Formage]]'''

|-

|-
|'''[[Julio G]]'''
|Julio G is the DJ for the [[Radio Los Santos (3D Universe)|Radio Los Santos]] radio station.<br />Voiced by: [[Julio G]].
|-
|'''[[Jack Howitzer (3D Universe)|Jack Howitzer]]'''

During the interview, he accidentally kills the host, [[Billy Dexter]], and is later put on trial for murder.<br />Voiced by: [[Randy Pearlstein]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
|-
|'''[[Michael Hunt]]'''
|Michael Hunt calls in to ''[[Gardening with Maurice]]'' asking how to get rid of the weeds on his driveway.<br />Voiced by: [[Russ Mottla]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'' and ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]''
|-
|'''[[Jimmy (actor)|Jimmy]]'''
|Jimmy is an actor who is interviewed, whilst being arrested for being in possession of an unnamed drug, by [[Richard Burns]] during a [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR]] News segment.<br />It is unknown who provided the voice for Jimmy.<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''
|-
|'''[[Johnny Lawton]]'''
|Johnny Lawton is one of the DJs for the [[K-Jah West]] radio station, alongside [[Marshall Peters]].<br />Voiced by: [[Robbie Shakespeare]].
|-
|'''[[Lazlow Jones (3D Universe)|Lazlow Jones]]'''
|Lazlow Jones is a former radio DJ who in the early part of [[1992]] is looking for work. He first phones in to ''I Say, You Say'' asking for a job. He later becomes the host of [[Entertaining America]] after the murder of the shows original host, [[Billy Dexter]].<br />Voiced by: Himself.<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'', ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]'', ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]'' and ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]]''
|-
|'''[[Christy MacIntyre]]'''
|[[Christy MacIntyre]] is the host of the [[Lonely Hearts]] show on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR]]. She had previously been romantically involved with [[Fernando Martinez (3D Universe)|Fernando Martinez]], who begins to harass her, at one point even setting fire to her car. Despite this, she again becomes romantically involved with Martinez.<br />Voiced by: Sara Moon.
|-
|'''[[Fernando Martinez (3D Universe)|Fernando Martinez]]'''
|Fernando Martinez is a former radio DJ who in [[1992]] begins to harass [[Christy MacIntyre]], having previously been romantically involved with her. He later hosts part of one of her ''Lonely Hearts'' shows after setting MacIntyre's car on fire. He later becomes romantically involved with MacIntyre.<br />Voiced by: [[Frank Chavez]].<br />Also appears in: ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'', ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]'' and ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]]''
|-
